structure Selection (G : SimpleGraph V) where
  root : V → V
  reachable : ∀ v,G.Reachable v (root v)
  constant : ∀ {u v},G.Reachable u v → root u=root v

noncomputable def rootCount (A : Instance I J) (S : Selection A.T)

def canonical {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : Selection G where
  root := FiniteGraphRoots.root G
  reachable := FiniteGraphRoots.root_reachable G
  constant := FiniteGraphRoots.root_constant G

def Selection.map {W : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (S : Selection G) (e : G ≃g H) : Selection H where
  root v := e (S.root (e.symm v))
  reachable v := by
    have h := (S.reachable (e.symm v)).map e.toHom
    change H.Reachable (e (e.symm v)) (e (S.root (e.symm v))) at h
    simpa only [RelIso.apply_symm_apply] using h
  constant h := congrArg e (S.constant (h.map e.symm.toHom))

    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,

    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

def EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1 : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Capacity n), (∀ u, c u u=0) →
    ∀ (s t : Fin n), s≠t →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n),
        AugmentationTrace c s t F → K≤n^3

abbrev Capacity (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℕ

/-- Skew flows combine the two antiparallel directions. The upper
capacity bound and skew symmetry give both directed residual bounds. -/
def IsMaximum {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  Feasible c s t f ∧ ∀ g, Feasible c s t g → value s g≤value s f

/-- A directed residual path with k arcs and no repeated vertices. -/
def maxFlow (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) : Flow n := run c s t (n^3+1)

abbrev Flow (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℤ
def AugmentationTrace {n K : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n) : Prop :=
  F 0=0 ∧
  (∀ i, Feasible c s t (F i)) ∧
  ∀ i : Fin K, ShortestAugmentation c s t (F i.castSucc) (F i.succ)

/-- The shortest-augmenting-path bound for integral skew flows.
Every finite initial segment has at most n³ augmentations, independently
of the rule used to break ties between shortest paths. -/

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),

    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

    ∀ (s t : Fin n), s≠t →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n),
        AugmentationTrace c s t F → K≤n^3

/-- Skew flows combine the two antiparallel directions. The upper
capacity bound and skew symmetry give both directed residual bounds. -/
abbrev Flow (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Fin n → ℤ
def AugmentationTrace {n K : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n) : Prop :=
  F 0=0 ∧
  (∀ i, Feasible c s t (F i)) ∧
  ∀ i : Fin K, ShortestAugmentation c s t (F i.castSucc) (F i.succ)

/-- The shortest-augmenting-path bound for integral skew flows.
Every finite initial segment has at most n³ augmentations, independently
of the rule used to break ties between shortest paths. -/
def HasMargins (X : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, ∑ j, X i j = r i) ∧ (∀ j, ∑ i, X i j = c j)

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,

    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤
      ∫ z in S₀, f₀ z

def FiniteCheeger : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : FiniteChain X) (κ : ℝ), 0 < κ →
    (∀ S : Finset X,

        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

end

  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →

    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤

    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

abbrev Profiles (small : I → J → Bool) (B : I → J → ℕ) :=

  toFun a := a ∘ (enumeration small).symm

  b : I → J → ℕ

  W : ℕ

  hcard : Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J≤d
  hW : 2≤W
  hlarge : ∀ i j, small i j=false → W≤b i j ∧ 1≤b i j
  hsmall : ∀ i j, small i j=true → b i j<W
  hX : ∀ i j, 0≤X i j ∧ X i j≤b i j

def rationalBinWidth (A : Instance I J) (C : ℕ) : ℕ := 16*C*A.d^2

  C*((rootCount A S x q:ℚ)+∑ t : TreeCell A.T,max 0 (max
    (-rationalScaledTree A S (CompanionOracleDensity.rationalBinWidth A C) x q v t)

def canonical {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : Selection G where
  root := FiniteGraphRoots.root G

def Selection.map {W : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (S : Selection G) (e : G ≃g H) : Selection H where
  root v := e (S.root (e.symm v))
  reachable v := by
    have h := (S.reachable (e.symm v)).map e.toHom
    change H.Reachable (e (e.symm v)) (e (S.root (e.symm v))) at h
    simpa only [RelIso.apply_symm_apply] using h
  constant h := congrArg e (S.constant (h.map e.symm.toHom))

  root v := e (S.root (e.symm v))
  reachable v := by
    have h := (S.reachable (e.symm v)).map e.toHom
    change H.Reachable (e (e.symm v)) (e (S.root (e.symm v))) at h
    simpa only [RelIso.apply_symm_apply] using h

    (by rw [← Finset.sum_div]; exact div_self (ne_of_gt (normalizer_pos w hw)))

/-- A uniform randomized Post-Turing machine: a single finite transition table. -/

  unfold experiment
  rw [Experiment.all_map]
  exact (Experiment.all_true _).mono (fun bs _ => hout bs)

is exactly the law obtained by feeding an independent uniform word to f. -/

    (ε δ : ℚ) (t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin t → Bool) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter fun bits => ∃ q : ℚ,

  induction p with

  | read p ih => exact ⟨ih false hp.1 hq.1,ih true hp.2 hq.2⟩
  | delay n p ih => exact ih hp hq

  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →

        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,
      (f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (f₂ y) ^ t ≤ f₀ ((1 - t) • x + t • y)) →
    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤
      ∫ z in S₀, f₀ z

        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

end

def largePadding (K : Finset (I × J)) (L : ℕ) : I → J → ℕ :=
  fun i j => if (i, j) ∈ K then L else 0

private theorem large_padding_good_card (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ)
    (K : Finset (I × J)) (L : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card {Y : Table (paddedRows r (largePadding K L))
        (paddedColumns c (largePadding K L)) //
      ¬∃ p : K, Y.val p.val.1 p.val.2 < L} = Fintype.card (Table r c) := by
  let P := largePadding K L
  let T := Table (paddedRows r P) (paddedColumns c P)
  have heq (Y : T) : (¬∃ p : K, Y.val p.val.1 p.val.2 < L) ↔
      ∀ i j, P i j ≤ Y.val i j := by
    constructor
    · intro hb i j
      by_cases hij : (i, j) ∈ K
      · have hn : ¬Y.val i j < L := fun h => hb ⟨⟨(i, j), hij⟩, h⟩
        simpa [P, largePadding, hij] using (show L ≤ Y.val i j by omega)
      · simp [P, largePadding, hij]
    · intro hg
      rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
      have h := hg p.val.1 p.val.2
      have hm : (p.val.1, p.val.2) ∈ K := p.property
      simp only [P, largePadding, hm, ite_true] at h
      omega
  have he : {Y : T // ¬∃ p : K, Y.val p.val.1 p.val.2 < L} ≃
      {Y : T // ∀ i j, P i j ≤ Y.val i j} := Equiv.subtypeEquivRight heq
  rw [Fintype.card_congr he]
  exact successful_card r c P

  let P := largePadding (paperLarge r c) L

    dsimp only [P,paperLarge]
    rw [large_padding_rows,large_padding_columns]
    exact Y.property

    intro i j
    cases hs : paperSmall r c i j with
    | false => simpa only [P,paperLarge,largePadding,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,

    ((dimensionAllowance (I := I) (J := J))^12) ((dimensionAllowance (I := I) (J := J))^20)
    (stateCapacity_small r c) a

    BalancedJoint (paperSmall r c) (stateCapacity r c) r c
      ((dimensionAllowance (I := I) (J := J))^12) ((dimensionAllowance (I := I) (J := J))^20) := by
  let d := dimensionAllowance (I := I) (J := J)
  let small := paperSmall r c
  let Y := paddedOriginal small (d^12) X
  have hR := paddedOriginal_small_rows small (d^12) X
  have hC := paddedOriginal_small_columns small (d^12) X
  refine jointOfTable small (stateCapacity r c) r c (d^12) (d^20)
    (stateCapacity_small r c) Y ?_ hR hC ?_
  · intro i j hs
    change X.val i j+(if small i j then 0 else d^12) ≤ d^20
    simpa only [hs,ite_true,Nat.add_zero] usi

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)

    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,

def chain (w : X → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    (Adj : X → X → Prop) (hsym : ∀ x y, Adj x y ↔ Adj y x)
    (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (D : ℕ)
    (hdegree : ∀ x, (Finset.univ.filter (Adj x)).card ≤ D)
    (hproposal : (D : ℝ) * β ≤ 1 / 2) : FiniteChain X :=
  FiniteChain.ofMoves (fun x => w x / normalizer w) (move w Adj β)
    (fun x => div_pos (hw x) (normalizer_pos w hw))
    (by rw [← Finset.sum_div]; exact div_self (ne_of_gt (normalizer_pos w hw)))
    (move_nonnegative w hw Adj β hβ)
    (move_row_bound w Adj β hβ D hdegree hproposal)

private lemma floor_step (x q : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    ⌊x+q⌋=⌊x⌋ ∨ ⌊x+q⌋=⌊x⌋+1 := by
  have hlo := Int.floor_mono (show x ≤ x+q by linarith)
  have hhi := Int.floor_mono (show x+q ≤ x+1 by linarith)
  rw [Int.floor_add_one] at hhi
  omega

/-- The actual phase observable takes exactly the two source values,
since one annealing step changes its integer exponent by zero or one. -/
@[reducible] def FreeIndex (small : I → J → Bool) (T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J))
    (b : I → J → ℕ) := (a : FreeCell small T) → Fin (b a.val.1 a.val.2+1)

def correctedMass (A : Instance I J) (C a : ℝ) (z : View A → ℕ)
    (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (f : FreeIndex A.small A.T A.b) : ℝ :=
  gridWeight A C a z (integerBin A K hK f)/binSum A C a z K/

def correction (A : Instance I J) (C a : ℝ) (z : View A → ℕ)

    rho A C a z (integerPoint A C f)/gridWeight A C a z (integerBin A K hK f)

noncomputable def pairs : List ((P × Bool) × (P × Bool)) :=

def pair (p : P) : (P × Bool) × (P × Bool) := ((p,false),(p,true))

structure RationalLaw (α : Type*) [Fintype α] where
  mass : α → ℚ
  nonnegative : ∀ x, 0 ≤ mass x
  total : ∑ x, mass x = 1

variable [Nonempty α]

def equivLaw (e : α ≃ β) (p : RationalLaw α) : RationalLaw β where
  mass := fun y => p.mass (e.symm y)
  nonnegative := fun y => p.nonnegative (e.symm y)
  total := by
    have h := Fintype.sum_equiv e p.mass (fun y => p.mass (e.symm y)) (fun x => by simp)
    rw [← h, p.total]

noncomputable def plainEquivChoices :
    {S : Set (Copy b×Bool) // PlainState pairs S} ≃ ((c : C) → Finset (Fin (b c))) where
  toFun S c := Finset.univ.filter (fun k => ((⟨c,k⟩,false):Copy b×Bool)∈S.val)
  invFun S := ⟨encode b S,encode_plain b S⟩
  left_inv S := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext ⟨⟨c,k⟩,t⟩
    have h := S.property (TwoLiftStates.pair (⟨c,k⟩:Copy b)) (pair_mem (⟨c,k⟩:Copy b))
    cases t
    · simp
    · simp only [encode_true,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
      change (¬((⟨c,k⟩,false):Copy b×Bool)∈S.val)↔((⟨c,k⟩,true):Copy b×Bool)∈S.val
      rcases h with ⟨ha,hb⟩|⟨ha,hb⟩ <;> simp [TwoLiftStates.pair] at ha hb ⊢ <;> tauto
  right_inv S := by
    funext c
    ext k
    simp

    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,

    (hl : l ≤ 2^b) (hs : s+1 ≤ 2^(4*b)) : l*s+1 ≤ 2^(6*b) := by
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul hl (show s ≤ 2^(4*b) by omega)
  have he : (2:ℕ)^b*2^(4*b)=2^(5*b) := by
    calc
      _ = 2^(b+4*b) := (pow_add 2 b (4*b)).symm
      _ = _ := congrArg (fun k : ℕ => (2:ℕ)^k) (by omega)
  rw [he] at hm
  have hp : 1 ≤ (2:ℕ)^(5*b) := one_le_pow₀ (by decide)
  calc
    _ ≤ 2*2^(5*b) := by omega
    _ = 2^(5*b+1) := by rw [pow_succ]; omega
    _ ≤ 2^(6*b) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

  ∑ t : DenseTrial R P d q, if TrialAccepted R P d e t then denseTrialMass R P d e t else 0

abbrev DenseTrial (R : Option I → ℕ) (P : Option J → ℕ) (d : ℕ) (q : ℕ) :=
  Grid (I := Fin q) (4 * d ^ 8) × Offset (integerWidth R P d)

def TrialAccepted (R : Option I → ℕ) (P : Option J → ℕ) (d : ℕ) (e : I × J ≃ Fin q)
    (t : DenseTrial R P d q) : Prop := ∀ i j, 0 ≤ DenseAffine.integerTable R P (trialFree R P d e t) i j

def denseTrialMass (R : Option I → ℕ) (P : Option J → ℕ) (d : ℕ)
    (e : I × J ≃ Fin q) (t : DenseTrial R P d q) : ℝ :=
  denseBinWeight R P d e t.1 /
    (∑ a : Grid (I := Fin q) (4 * d ^ 8), denseBinWeight R P d e a) /
      Fintype.card (Offset (integerWidth R P d))

abbrev Grid (K : ℕ) := I → Set.Icc (0 : ℤ) ((K : ℤ) - 1)

def integerTable (R : Option I → ℕ) (P : Option J → ℕ) (z : I × J → ℕ) :
    Option I → Option J → ℤ
  | some i, some j => z (i, j)
  | some i, none => R (some i) - ∑ j, (z (i, j) : ℤ)
  | none, some j => P (some j) - ∑ i, (z (i, j) : ℤ)
  | none, none => R none - ∑ j, (P (some j) : ℤ) + ∑ i, ∑ j, (z (i, j) : ℤ)

def trialFree (R : Option I → ℕ) (P : Option J → ℕ) (d : ℕ) (e : I × J ≃ Fin q)
    (t : DenseTrial R P d q) : I × J → ℕ :=
  fun p => (trialBoxEquiv e (integerWidth R P d) (4 * d ^ 8) t p).val

    (e : I × J ≃ Fin q) (a : Grid (I := Fin q) K) : ℝ :=

def trialBoxEquiv (e : I × J ≃ Fin q) (w : I × J → ℕ) (K : ℕ) :
    Grid (I := Fin q) K × Offset w ≃ FreeBox w K where
  toFun t p := finProdFinEquiv (gridCoordinateFin K (t.1 (e p)), t.2 p)
  invFun z :=
    (fun j => (gridCoordinateFin K).symm
      (((finProdFinEquiv : Fin K × Fin (w (e.symm j)) ≃ Fin (K * w (e.symm j))).symm
        (z (e.symm j))).1),
     fun p => ((finProdFinEquiv : Fin K × Fin (w p) ≃ Fin (K * w p)).symm (z p)).2)
  left_inv t := by
    rcases t with ⟨a, o⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext j
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    · funext p
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  right_inv z := by
    funext p
    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have hb : ((finProdFinEquiv : Fin K × Fin (w (e.symm (e p))) ≃
        Fin (K * w (e.symm (e p)))).symm (z (e.symm (e p)))).1 =
        ((finProdFinEquiv : Fin K × Fin (w p) ≃ Fin (K * w p)).symm (z p)).1 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      change (z (e.symm (e p))).val / w (e.symm (e p)) = (z p).val / w p
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [hb]
    exact finProdFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply (z p)

    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg z.property.1
  right_inv v := by

    exact Int.toNat_natCast _

private theorem dense_cellScale_pos (R : Option I → ℕ) (P : Option J → ℕ)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 14 ≤ d) (hR : ∀ i, d ^ 12 ≤ R i) (hP : ∀ j, d ^ 12 ≤ P j)

  apply lt_min
  · exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (pow_pos (show 0 < d by omega) _) (hR g.1))

def entryCoeff (w : I → J → ℝ) : (Option I × Option J) → (I × J) → ℝ
  | (some i, some j), p => if p = (i, j) then w i j else 0
  | (some i, none), p => if p.1 = i then -w p.1 p.2 else 0
  | (none, some j), p => if p.2 = j then -w p.1 p.2 else 0
  | (none, none), p => w p.1 p.2

  offset + ∑ j, coeff j * x j

def EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1 : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Capacity n), (∀ u, c u u=0) →
    ∀ (s t : Fin n), s≠t →

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

def integerParts (R : Option I → ℕ) (P : Option J → ℕ) (z : I×J → ℕ) :
    Option I → Option J → ℕ×ℕ
  | some i,some j => (z (i,j),0)
  | some i,none => (R (some i),∑ j,z (i,j))
  | none,some j => (P (some j),∑ i,z (i,j))
  | none,none => (R none+∑ i,∑ j,z (i,j),∑ j,P (some j))

def integerTable (R : Option I → ℕ) (P : Option J → ℕ) (z : I × J → ℕ) :
    Option I → Option J → ℤ
  | some i, some j => z (i, j)
  | some i, none => R (some i) - ∑ j, (z (i, j) : ℤ)
  | none, some j => P (some j) - ∑ i, (z (i, j) : ℤ)
  | none, none => R none - ∑ j, (P (some j) : ℤ) + ∑ i, ∑ j, (z (i, j) : ℤ)

  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul hl (show s ≤ 2^(4*b) by omega)
  have he : (2:ℕ)^b*2^(4*b)=2^(5*b) := by

/-- Keep one public enumeration instance for the paper's state type, so
rational laws and generic finite kernels share the same index. -/
def unitSmallChain : FiniteChain (PaperStates r c) :=
  MetropolisChain.chain (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => by norm_num) Adj
    (physicalAdjacent_symmetric r c _ _ (stateCapacity r c) (stateCapacity_small r c))
    (smallProposal d) ((smallProposal_bounds d (by unfold dimensionAllowance; omega)).1.le)
    (5*d^2+1)
    (physicalAdjacent_degree_allowance r c _ _ (stateCapacity r c) (stateCapacity_small r c))
    (smallProposal_degree d (by unfold dimensionAllowance; omega))

noncomputable def stateWeight (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) (z : PaperStates r c) : ℝ :=
  hardMarginal (paperSmall r c) (stateCapacity r c) r c
    ((dimensionAllowance (I := I) (J := J))^12)
    (physicalProfile _ (stateCapacity r c) r c _ z)

def chain (w : X → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x)
    (Adj : X → X → Prop) (hsym : ∀ x y, Adj x y ↔ Adj y x)
    (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (D : ℕ)
    (hdegree : ∀ x, (Finset.univ.filter (Adj x)).card ≤ D)
    (hproposal : (D : ℝ) * β ≤ 1 / 2) : FiniteChain X :=
  FiniteChain.ofMoves (fun x => w x / normalizer w) (move w Adj β)
    (fun x => div_pos (hw x) (normalizer_pos w hw))
    (by rw [← Finset.sum_div]; exact div_self (ne_of_gt (normalizer_pos w hw)))
    (move_nonnegative w hw Adj β hβ)
    (move_row_bound w Adj β hβ D hdegree hproposal)
    (move_reversible w hw Adj hsym β)

    fullHardFamily small B r c L
      (physicalProfile (fun a : I×J => small a.1 a.2) (fun a => B a.1 a.2) z a)

    Profiles M ≃ SmallProfiles small M×PhysicalAssignments small M where
  toFun a := (fun s => a s.val,fun l => a l.val)
  invFun a c := if hs : small c=true then a.1 ⟨c,hs⟩
    else a.2 ⟨c,Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hs⟩
  left_inv a := by funext c; dsimp only; split_ifs <;> rfl
  right_inv a := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext s
      simp only [s.property,dite_eq_left]
    · funext l
      simp only [l.property,Bool.false_eq_true,dite_false]

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,
      (f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (f₂ y) ^ t ≤ f₀ ((1 - t) • x + t • y)) →
    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤
      ∫ z in S₀, f₀ z

/-- Log-concavity is needed only on the common ambient box. -/
def FiniteCheeger : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : FiniteChain X) (κ : ℝ), 0 < κ →
    (∀ S : Finset X,
      κ * min (∑ x ∈ S, C.π x) (∑ x ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x) ≤
        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

end

declarations.moduleDocumentation:
# Canonical paired-label order for the initial binary program

The order is the explicit list of cells, then their copies, then the
two sides of each pair. The code is obtained directly from the sampled
Boolean rows, so no enumeration of the set-valued state space occurs.

def copyOrder : List (Copy b) := (List.finRange q).sigma (fun i => List.finRange (b i))

abbrev Copy := Σ c, Fin (b c)
